messages.content: 紐約和洛杉磯之間，如果以公共交通工具中的巴士為首選，最短的距離是多少？如果允許在不同的交通工具之間轉乘，最短的距離又是多少？

function.name: city_distance_find_shortest
function.description: Calculates the shortest distance between two cities via available public transportation. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

2) With transfer allowed: same but allow_transfer=true.
